entries.reason: `IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF` after the blank-account test: 1210 is performed only from 1200 (1435) as the first edit of a task, so nothing has written WS-RETURN-MSG since 0000-MAIN:876 cleared it. The message is always off here.

`IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF` after the not-numeric/zero test: 1210 is the first edit of the task (1200:1435) and the 1791 arm that sets a message leaves through GO TO 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT, so the message is always off here (0000-MAIN:876 clears it).

`WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE`: 0000-MAIN (979) sends a task that arrives with ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION 'C' (or 'L'/'F') back to a fresh search before it performs 2000; 2614 sets 'C' only inside this same EVALUATE, after the WHEN list was chosen. The state is never 'C' when the EVALUATE is entered.

`IF INPUT-ERROR OR NO-CHANGES-DETECTED` under `WHEN ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS`: the state stays 'S' through 1200 only on the 1463 early exit, which follows 1205 finding NO-CHANGES-FOUND; 1205 sets NO-CHANGES-DETECTED (1769) in the same pass (an edit that finds a change sets 'E', 1470, then 'N' at 1674). So 'S' here always has NO-CHANGES-DETECTED set.
inside `WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE` (2625), which no task reaches (see the 2563 WHEN@2625 entry).
inside `WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE` (2625), which no task reaches (see the 2563 WHEN@2625 entry).

`WHEN OTHER` after NOT-FETCHED, SHOW-DETAILS and CHANGES-MADE: with ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION a single byte, those 88s (LOW-VALUES, SPACES, 'S', 'E', 'N', 'C', 'L', 'F') cover every value that reaches 3200; any other byte abends in 2000 (2637) before the map is built.

`IF FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER OR FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER`: 3202 is performed for a fetched-details state, and every such task ran 1200, which sets both found flags (1455-1458) before it can leave; 3202 does not reset them (2788 clears only WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS).
`IF FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER`: set together with FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER at 1455-1458 on every task that reaches 3202 (see 2793).

`WHEN WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE`: the earlier WHENs cover every ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION value a task can reach 3250 with (LOW-VALUES, SPACES, 'S', 'E', 'N', 'C', 'L', 'F'; any other byte abends in 2000); this arm is entered only for a state none of them names.
no WHEN matches: the WHENs name every ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION value that reaches 3250 (see the WHEN@2975 entry).
`IF WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE`: 3250 runs before 3390 in 3000-SEND-MAP (2654, 2658) and sets WS-INFO-MSG to a non-blank prompt in every reachable WHEN (see 3250), so the message is never blank here.

`IF DID-NOT-FIND-ACCT-IN-ACCTDAT` is an 88 on WS-RETURN-MSG with the value 'Did not find this account in account master file'; the only SET of it is commented out (3719), and 9300 writes 'Account:... not found in Acct Master file.Resp:...' instead. The message never has that value.

`IF DID-NOT-FIND-CUST-IN-CUSTDAT` is an 88 on WS-RETURN-MSG with the value 'Did not find associated customer in master file'; the only SET of it is commented out (3769), and 9400 writes 'CustId:... not found in...'. The message never has that value.

`IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF` in the xref NOTFND arm: 9200 is the first read of 9000 (3617) and 9000 is performed with the message off (2574 sets it off for PF12; on the not-fetched path 1210 ran and a message there sets FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK, which 2573 tests first).

`IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF` in the account NOTFND arm: 9300 runs after a NORMAL xref read (3617-3624; a NOTFND/other there sets FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and 9000 leaves at 3620), and a NORMAL read writes no message.

`IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF` after a failed account lock: PF5 is acted on only in state 'N' (2601), where 1200 left through its 1463 early exit before any edit, so no message was written; 0000-MAIN:876 cleared it.
`IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF` after a failed customer lock: same as 3911, and the account READ UPDATE that preceded it (NORMAL) writes no message.

`IF DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE` is an 88 on WS-RETURN-MSG, set only at 4143 and 4189 in 9700, each followed at once by GO TO 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT: control leaves 9600 for 2000 without returning to 3950, so the test never sees the message set.

`IF ABEND-MSG EQUAL LOW-VALUES`: ABEND-MSG is `PIC X(72) VALUE SPACES` (CSMSG02Y, lines 19-20), a separate 01-level ABEND-DATA that no INITIALIZE of the program names, and the program writes it only at 2637-2638 (a non-blank literal) and 4206. It is never LOW-VALUES.
